features.name: Task Creation
features.description: Users can create new tasks with title and description.
user_stories: As a user, I can create a new task so that I can track things I need to do.
As a user, I can add a description to my task so that I can remember important details.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am on the task list page, When I click create task and enter details, Then a new task appears in my list.
Given I am creating a task, When I submit without a title, Then I see a validation error message.

features.name: Task Completion
features.description: Users can mark tasks as complete to track progress.
user_stories: As a user, I can mark a task as complete so that I can track my progress.
As a user, I can see completed tasks separately so that I can focus on pending work.
acceptance_criteria: Given I have an incomplete task, When I click the complete button, Then the task is marked as completed.
Given I have completed tasks, When I view my task list, Then completed tasks are visually distinguished from incomplete ones.

features.name: Task Deletion
features.description: Users can permanently delete tasks they no longer need.
user_stories: As a user, I can delete a task so that I can remove items I no longer need.
As a user, I can confirm deletion so that I don't accidentally remove important tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Given I have a task, When I click delete and confirm, Then the task is permanently removed from my list.
Given I click delete, When the confirmation dialog appears, Then I can cancel to keep the task.

features.name: Task Listing
features.description: Users can view all their tasks in an organized list.
user_stories: As a user, I can view all my tasks in one place so that I can see what needs to be done.
As a user, I can see task details at a glance so that I can quickly understand my workload.
acceptance_criteria: Given I have created tasks, When I open the app, Then I see a list of all my tasks.
Given I have no tasks, When I open the app, Then I see a message indicating my task list is empty.

relationships.notes: Each task belongs to one user

assumptions: Users must be authenticated to manage tasks
Tasks are soft-deleted or hard-deleted based on business requirements
Task completion is a boolean flag that can be toggled
